```{r}
# ============================================================
# PUBLICATION-STYLE TABLE 1: LENGTH OF HOSPITAL STAY
# ============================================================

# Install packages if necessary
# install.packages(c("dplyr", "tidyr", "purrr",
#                    "flextable", "officer"))

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(flextable)
library(officer)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Define variables
# ------------------------------------------------------------

categorical_vars <- c(
  "sex",
  "referral",
  "cormobid_condition",
  "antibiotics_prescribed",
  "growth1",
  "Resistance",
  "name_of_rrh",
  "ward"
)

continuous_vars <- c(
  "age", "num_infection_sites"
)

variable_labels <- c(
  sex = "Sex",
  referral = "Referral",
  cormobid_condition = "Comorbid condition",
  antibiotics_prescribed = "Antibiotics prescribed",
  growth1 = "Culture growth",
  Resistance = "Antibiotic resistance",
  name_of_rrh = "Regional referral hospital",
  ward = "Hospital ward",
  age = "Age",
  num_infection_sites = "Number of infection sites"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Formatting functions
# ------------------------------------------------------------

fmt_p <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) return("")
  if (p < 0.001) return("<0.001")
  sprintf("%.3f", p)
}

fmt_mean <- function(x) {
  sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", mean(x), sd(x))
}

fmt_median <- function(x) {
  q <- quantile(x, c(0.25, 0.50, 0.75))
  sprintf("%.2f (%.2f–%.2f)", q[2], q[1], q[3])
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Overall summary
# ------------------------------------------------------------

overall <- data %>%
  filter(!is.na(length_hosp_stay))

overall_row <- tibble(
  Characteristic = "Overall",
  N = as.character(nrow(overall)),
  `Mean LOS (SD)` = fmt_mean(overall$length_hosp_stay),
  `Median LOS (IQR)` = fmt_median(overall$length_hosp_stay),
  `Mean difference (95% CI)` = "",
  `Regression coefficient (95% CI)` = "",
  `p-value` = ""
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Categorical variables
# ------------------------------------------------------------

categorical_table <- purrr::map_dfr(categorical_vars, function(var) {

  d <- data %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(.data[[var]]),
      !is.na(length_hosp_stay)
    ) %>%
    mutate(Category = droplevels(as.factor(.data[[var]])))

  groups <- levels(d$Category)

  if (length(groups) < 2) return(tibble())

  # Dynamic formula
  test_formula <- reformulate(
    "Category",
    response = "length_hosp_stay"
  )

  # Statistical tests
  if (length(groups) == 2) {

    p <- wilcox.test(
      test_formula,
      data = d
    )$p.value

    # Welch mean difference and 95% CI
    welch <- t.test(
      test_formula,
      data = d
    )

    md <- mean(
      d$length_hosp_stay[d$Category == groups[2]]
    ) -
      mean(
        d$length_hosp_stay[d$Category == groups[1]]
      )

    mean_diff <- sprintf(
      "%.2f (%.2f to %.2f)",
      md,
      welch$conf.int[1],
      welch$conf.int[2]
    )

  } else {

    p <- kruskal.test(
      test_formula,
      data = d
    )$p.value

    mean_diff <- ""
  }

  # Variable heading
  heading <- tibble(
    Characteristic = unname(variable_labels[var]),
    N = "",
    `Mean LOS (SD)` = "",
    `Median LOS (IQR)` = "",
    `Mean difference (95% CI)` = mean_diff,
    `Regression coefficient (95% CI)` = "",
    `p-value` = fmt_p(p)
  )

  # Category summaries
  category_rows <- d %>%
    group_by(Category) %>%
    summarise(
      N = n(),
      Mean = mean(length_hosp_stay),
      SD = sd(length_hosp_stay),
      Q1 = quantile(length_hosp_stay, 0.25),
      Median = median(length_hosp_stay),
      Q3 = quantile(length_hosp_stay, 0.75),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Characteristic = paste0("   ", as.character(Category)),
      N = as.character(N),
      `Mean LOS (SD)` = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", Mean, SD),
      `Median LOS (IQR)` = sprintf(
        "%.2f (%.2f–%.2f)", Median, Q1, Q3
      ),
      `Mean difference (95% CI)` = "",
      `Regression coefficient (95% CI)` = "",
      `p-value` = ""
    ) %>%
    select(
      Characteristic,
      N,
      `Mean LOS (SD)`,
      `Median LOS (IQR)`,
      `Mean difference (95% CI)`,
      `Regression coefficient (95% CI)`,
      `p-value`
    )

  bind_rows(heading, category_rows)

})

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Continuous variables
# ------------------------------------------------------------

continuous_table <- map_dfr(continuous_vars, function(var) {

  d <- data %>%
    select(
      x = all_of(var),
      length_hosp_stay
    ) %>%
    drop_na()

  # Linear regression
  model <- lm(length_hosp_stay ~ x, data = d)

  coef <- summary(model)$coefficients
  ci <- confint(model)["x", ]

  beta <- coef["x", "Estimate"]
  p <- coef["x", "Pr(>|t|)"]

  # Median and IQR of the continuous explanatory variable
  median_x <- median(d$x, na.rm = TRUE)
  q1 <- quantile(d$x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
  q3 <- quantile(d$x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)

  tibble(
    Characteristic = paste0(
      unname(variable_labels[var]),
      " (per unit increase)"
    ),
    N = as.character(nrow(d)),

    `Median (IQR)` = sprintf(
      "%.2f (%.2f–%.2f)",
      median_x, q1, q3
    ),

    `Mean difference (95% CI)` = "",

    `Regression coefficient (95% CI)` = sprintf(
      "%.2f (%.2f to %.2f)",
      beta, ci[1], ci[2]
    ),

    `p-value` = fmt_p(p)
  )
})

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Combine into ONE table
# ------------------------------------------------------------

final_publication_table <- bind_rows(
  overall_row,
  categorical_table,
  continuous_table
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Create publication-style Word table
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ft <- flextable(final_publication_table)

ft <- theme_booktabs(ft)

ft <- bold(ft, part = "header")
ft <- fontsize(ft, size = 9, part = "all")

ft <- align(ft, align = "center", part = "all")

ft <- align(
  ft,
  j = "Characteristic",
  align = "left",
  part = "all"
)

# Bold variable headings
heading_names <- unname(variable_labels[categorical_vars])

heading_rows <- which(
  final_publication_table$Characteristic %in% heading_names
)

ft <- bold(
  ft,
  i = heading_rows,
  j = 1:7,
  bold = TRUE
)

# Bold overall row
ft <- bold(ft, i = 1, j = 1:7, bold = TRUE)

ft <- valign(ft, valign = "center", part = "all")

# Allow table to fit on landscape page
ft <- autofit(ft)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Export to Word
# ------------------------------------------------------------

doc <- read_docx()

doc <- body_end_section_landscape(doc)

doc <- body_add_par(
  doc,
  "Table 1. Length of Hospital Stay by Explanatory Characteristics",
  style = "heading 1"
)

doc <- body_add_flextable(doc, ft)

doc <- body_add_par(
  doc,
  paste(
    "Values are presented as mean (SD) and median (IQR).",
    "Mean differences are calculated as the second category",
    "minus the first category, with 95% confidence intervals",
    "from Welch's t-test.",
    "Wilcoxon rank-sum tests are used for binary categorical",
    "variables and Kruskal-Wallis tests for categorical",
    "variables with more than two groups.",
    "Continuous variables are analysed using linear regression."
  ),
  style = "Normal"
)

print(
  doc,
  target = "Publication_Table1_Length_of_Hospital_Stay.docx"
)

# Confirm export location
getwd()

```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(gtsummary)

# Convert categorical variables to factors
data2 <- data2 %>%
  mutate(
    sex = as.factor(sex),
    anyComorbidity = as.factor(anyComorbidity),
    treatOutcome = as.factor(treatOutcome),
    anyResistance = as.factor(anyResistance),
    site = as.factor(site),
    ward = as.factor(ward),
    antib_prior_admi = as.factor(antib_prior_admi)
  )

# Generate Table 1
table1 <- data2 %>%
  select(
    age,
    sex,
    anyComorbidity,
    antib_prior_admi,
    anyResistance,
    site,
    ward,
    treatOutcome
  ) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    by = treatOutcome,
    type = list(
      age ~ "continuous",
      sex ~ "categorical",
      anyComorbidity ~ "categorical",
      antib_prior_admi ~ "categorical",
      anyResistance ~ "categorical",
      site ~ "categorical",
      ward ~ "categorical"
    ),
    statistic = list(
      age ~ "{median} ({p25}, {p75})",
      all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"
    ),
    digits = list(
      age ~ 2,
      all_categorical() ~ c(0, 1)
    ),
    missing = "ifany",
    missing_text = "Missing"
  ) %>%
  add_overall(last = FALSE) %>%
  add_p() %>%
  bold_labels()

# Display table
table1
```
